## At a glance

- **Session.** Session 1, played on 14 and 15 Eelrun 412 CY. See [[Session 1 - Prep]]. The account read aloud at the start of the next Session is [[Session 1 - Previously On]].
- **Party at.** [[Gullhook Lighthouse]], at dawn on 15 Eelrun.
- **Big moments.** The ferry grounded when the lamp died. The Party fought goblin arsonists on Pier Row and faced [[Ilse Corran]] in the lamp room.
- **Left open.** A bell rang once from the flats. Ilse escaped and knows the Party's faces.

## What happened

The Marl Ferry grounded on a mud bank when the Gullhook lamp went out. [[Tamsin Wick]] recognised the unlit skiff's signal code, and the Party freed the ferry with [[Pell Rushlight]] and reached the [[Saltwick]] stairs.

[[Hobb Tarrow]] hired the Party in his office to keep the lamp lit through the Long Ebb. He agreed to 300 gold pieces after some bargaining. He showed the pattern of wrecks on his chart, and [[Odalys Ferro]] saw that he was holding something back about the last keeper.

That night five goblin hands of [[The Reedrunners]] burned the oil warehouse on Pier Row. The Party fought them, saved half the barrels and captured one goblin. [[Brannoch Vell]] carried two trapped workers out of the eel sheds.

At the lighthouse the Party found [[Ilse Corran]] in the lamp room with two goblins and a line of oil across the floor. Ilse offered to pay for a dark harbor. The Party refused, and the fight ended when Ilse dropped the lantern, took a wound from Tamsin's shortbow and escaped down a rope through the seaward window. The Party put out the fire and lit the lamp again.

Hobb lent the Party the Ebb Lantern and 100 gold pieces as an advance. At dawn, a bell rang once from the flats near [[Reedholt]].

## Changes

- [[Keep Gullhook Lit]] is now active, with 100 of the 300 gold pieces paid.
- [[Ilse Corran]] is wounded and has left Saltwick, and she knows the Party.
- [[Hobb Tarrow]] lent the [[Ebb Lantern]] to the Party.
- [[Gullhook Lighthouse]] has lost half its oil to the fire but has a lit lamp.
- [[Tamsin Wick]] was called by her childhood name by Ilse.
- [[Brannoch Vell]] heard that a Reedrunner crew disappeared two years ago.

## Threads

- [[Reedrunner Tithe]] moved. Ilse was wounded and the crew failed to take the oil, so the ferries are next.
- [[The Silent Bell]] opened. The Party heard a bell fifty days before the Long Ebb.
